sections.name: Hook
lines: f_hook
When you glance at your phone to unlock it, it can secretly cover your face in thousands of invisible dots.
f_title
Here's how your phone knows it's you, in five steps.

sections.name: Invisible light
lines: f_flood
Step one. On phones with 3D face unlock, a tiny flood light washes your face in infrared light, which your eyes can't see. That's why it works in the dark.
f_dots
Then a projector beams more than thirty thousand infrared dots onto your face.

sections.name: Reading the shape
lines: f_camera
Step two. An infrared camera photographs those dots. On a flat wall, they'd sit in neat rows.
f_depth
But on your face, they bend around your nose, cheeks and chin. From that, the phone builds a 3D map of your face.

sections.name: Faces into numbers
lines: f_math
Step three. That map gets turned into a long list of numbers, a mathematical description of your face.
f_compare
It's compared with the one saved when you set it up. Close enough? Unlocked.
f_fast
The whole thing, from glance to unlock, takes well under a second.
f_secure
That description isn't a photo. It's kept in a secure chip on the phone, and isn't sent off to the cloud.

sections.name: Real and paying attention
lines: f_attention
Step four. It can also check that your eyes are open and looking at the screen, so it won't unlock while you're asleep.
f_photo
And because it reads real 3D shape, a flat photo of you won't fool it.

sections.name: Changing faces
lines: f_adapt
Step five. Glasses, a new beard, a hat? It keeps learning, updating your saved face as you change.
f_odds
The chance a random stranger unlocks it is about one in a million. Though an identical twin might just manage it.
f_2d
Some phones skip the dots, and just use the normal front camera. That's easier to fool, so it often isn't allowed for payments.

sections.name: Recap
lines: w_recap
Infrared light floods your face. Dots map its shape. The shape becomes numbers, and the numbers get compared, right there on your phone.
outro
So every glance is a quick 3D scan. Follow for more of the tech you use every day.
